pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/29078

Also moved the `Http3Supported` attribute to kestrel shared test root, next to `MSQuicSupported` attribute.

issue_context.title: Http/3 for IIS
issue_context.body:
We'll need some basic tests for Http/3 support on IIS including:
- The bindings work as expected
- The protocol version is correctly reported
- Hello World requests
- gRPC scenarios (Reset, Trailers)
- Interop with HttpClient

We can use the new windows preview helix queue to run these.
